corrections.text: The article states that Emma Smith posted an update narrowing the pre-PEP's scope to optional-only Rust modules "within a day" of her original November 2025 post, quoting that update directly. The cited discuss.python.org thread does not corroborate this timing, and The Register -- the article's own primary source -- states the scope was narrowed "in May" (2026), several months after the original post, not the next day. The underlying fact that the pre-PEP was eventually narrowed to optional-only modules, with the required-dependency question deferred to a future PEP, is accurate and independently corroborated; only the "within a day"/November 2025 timing of that update is incorrect.
